sourceQuote: All the students learning Chinese, the senior scholars and the visiting scholars in the School of International Education, who apply for the degree education of undergraduate, master and doctor and are accepted by CUPL, can obtain the scholarship.
targetQuote: 所有学习中文的学生，以及申请本科、硕士和博士学历教育并被 CUPL 录取的国际教育学院高年级学者和访问学者，均可获得奖学金。
